title: Three Roads to Ruin
premise: Gantt's dispatch named three towns going under in one month and said somebody was being paid for it. Pritchard has one deputy, a shaking hand and a stranger who walked out of a train wreck. He puts three things on his desk, a rail spike, a grain scoop and a miner's brass tag, and says to pick one up. Each is a road, each road is a different kind of trouble, and one of them is enough to bring the valley to the fair.

places.name: The Warden's office, Mercy Crossing
places.what: Pritchard's desk, with the three tokens on it and a drawer he does not open

places.name: The town gate
places.what: Where Talbot stands, and where he is carried back in if the stranger will not go

stages.set_by: Speaking to Pritchard once Six Rounds to Mercy is complete
stages.log: Pritchard has three troubles and one deputy. A rail spike for Iron Junction. A grain scoop for Greenwater. A brass tag for Red Hollow. He says pick one up.
Iron Junction is settled, one way or another.
Greenwater is settled, one way or another.

stages.set_by: What Knocks in Red Hollow (mq02c) completing
stages.log: Red Hollow is settled, one way or another.

stages.set_by: The button 'Send your deputy.' at Pritchard's desk
stages.log: You told Pritchard to send his deputy. Jonah Talbot went up the pike alone with a clean gun.

stages.set_by: Telling Pritchard what happened on any one road
stages.log: Pritchard has heard one road's worth. It was enough to make him get the good paper out.

stages.set_by: The morning after stage 50, at the town gate
stages.log: They carried Jonah Talbot back in through the gate on a door.

stages.set_by: Pritchard calling the fair, after stage 60 or stage 70
stages.log: Pritchard is done guessing. He has sent to every flag in the valleys: come to the camp-ground on Decoration Day and say it to each other's faces.

objectives.text: Take a road: rail to Iron Junction, river to Greenwater, or the pike to Red Hollow
See who they are carrying in at the gate

options.label: The spike. I'll take the rail.
options.now: Starts The Night Mail: the yard at Iron Junction expects a gun for its mail train
options.later: Iron Junction is the road that answers who signed for the train you walked out of

options.label: The scoop. I'll go by river.
options.now: Starts The Queen of Tellico: a skiff is waiting at the landing
options.later: Greenwater is the road that decides whether a town eats this winter

options.label: The tag. I'll walk the pike.
options.now: Starts What Knocks in Red Hollow: the Dominion's toll-gate and a hanging are on the way
options.later: Red Hollow is the road that finds out the valley is not the only place with people in it

options.label: Send your deputy.
options.now: Talbot rides out in your place
options.later: He comes back shot. The fair is called anyway, with every road gone the worst way and Pritchard short a deputy

ways_through: Take any one road, come back, and tell Pritchard. Nothing optional is needed and the other two roads may be left alone.
Take two or all three roads in any order. Each adds a piece of silver to the case and changes who stands where at the fair.
Refuse. Talbot goes instead and is carried back the next morning. The fair is called without anything learned.
cannot_break: The roads can be taken in any order, left half done or never started. A road abandoned midway settles itself the worst way when the fair is called. If Pritchard is somehow gone, the notice of the fair is on the board and the chapter completes on reading it. Talbot cannot die of the wound.

new_flags.name: talbot_shot
new_flags.meaning: The stranger refused all three roads; Talbot went, was shot, and spends the rest of the act in Keene's clinic

open_questions: Is one road really enough to open Chapter 3, or should it be two?
Should a refused road be allowed to be picked up again after Talbot is hurt?
